memories.content: OpenCode V2 plugin delivered at addons/opencode (28 tools, 10 commands, 3 skills, hooks, MCP auto-registration). Skill.Info requires path or plugin gets disabled. options.baseUrl must propagate via RUNTIME_BASE. Kernel v1.0.14 adds 6 router tools via kernel_bridge.go. Verified 196/196.

Added memory_delete + hn-restore + file observations + assistant feed; fixed hn-purge {tag}->{id}; parallel hot path + negative caching; PS5.1 Set-Content utf8 writes BOM - strip with byte writes; concurrent pi-agent commit 8849daf04 stacked cleanly. Verified 269/269.

memory_relate + real e2e battery (opencode HTTP API). memory_store id fix (data.memory.id). Shared batteries must use floor+required-names for multi-agent growth. opencode CLI = npm .ps1 shim -> cmd.exe /c; /api/plugin is location-scoped; command body {name,text}. 285/285 across 7 batteries.

memories.json torn-read corruption fixed (atomic rename + salvage loader + RMW mutex, 1872 records repaired). Full stdio-router parity (10 tools ported, click_chat_button dispatch fixed). Audit batching N->1 writes. MCP stale state needs service restart. 293/293 across 7 batteries.

Kernel-fatal repograph race fixed (mid-build map publish vs readers - unrecoverable concurrent map fatal). 32 bridge handlers now return upstream data. Schema authority over stale caches. lightweightSymbolSearch bounded. Full Go suites green + 293 battery assertions.

addons/jcode/ full integration: mcp.json (.jcode + ~/.jcode), 3 skills, prompt-overlay, preferred-tools, swarm-prompt block, install.mjs idempotent installer. Kernel mcp_server.go fix: tools/list degraded to 49 tools under load (3s fetch, no cache) now 8s+retry+15s last-good cache + concurrent stdio dispatch. Batteries: jcode-ext 43/43, mcp-tools 23, sweep 54, core-noext 18, mimo 51, TUI 16, opencode 120. Gotchas: search_memory needs natural-language tokens; delete propagates async.

recoverMiddleware (panics no longer kill kernel) + debug.SetCrashOutput crash capture to .hypernexus/kernel-crash.log. Go test -timeout 25m needed under load. Swap recipe: kill->verify gone->copy->verify size->delete staged. 293 battery assertions green.

Second kernel-fatal race fixed: PreemptiveAdvertiser cooldown map read outside lock (unlocked read vs locked write still fatal). OnMessage zero-Timestamp silent drop fixed. Hot-path race audit clean otherwise. 293 batteries + Go suites green, crash log empty.
